title: Mlai entry scenario train test gap
topic: Mlai entry scenario train test gap
question: What's likely going on here, and what would you check first?
idealAnswer:
The large gap between training and test accuracy is the classic signature of overfitting, the model has memorized the training data rather than learning generalizable patterns

First check: confirm the train/test split itself is valid, no data leakage where test examples, or near-duplicates, also appear in training

Check model complexity relative to dataset size, a very complex model with limited training data is prone to memorizing

Consider whether regularization, dropout, or early stopping were used at all during training

Look at the learning curves (train vs validation loss over epochs) to see when and how the gap opens up, which points to whether it's a capacity, data, or training-duration issue
